negative_policy: Reuse every original expected failure, exact rollback, failed unpartitioned-reference diagnostic and convergence failure; no deletion or reinterpretation to obtain pass. Add parser rejection separately: missing/empty/short/nonfinite state and missing/short/nonfinite/malformed loading must return nonzero and ok=false; parser rejection need not fabricate a state. Every rejection followed by exact full same-backend valid zero-load result.
gamma_policy: DP/MCC full public solve-vector still requires gamma slot; do not silently shorten vector. Its v0.3 role is plastic_multiplier, not persistent. Change incoming gamma only to0.125 and require exact zero-load result equality; solver.reset_transients is the source. No claim that API rejects any finite gamma history.
backend_policy: Each backend independently passes every original oracle gate. Retain complete raw requests/stdout/stderr/results/state, not selected stress components. Do not use parity as independent science. One persistent Wasm engine instance handles all calls including failure/retry; native CLI retries are separate processes and do not qualify in-process host recovery.
freeze_policy: Acyclic source-freeze BEFORE build: exact current source/reference/tool/model/collector identities and explicit toolchain executable hashes. Parent serial actual configure/build receipt binds that prefreeze and complete generated/log/artifact hashes. Postbuild freeze extends unchanged source-freeze with actual artifact identities BEFORE qualification calls. All output identities are new, never overwritten.

numeric_adapter_policy: Native-style finite decimal and exact binary64 round-to-nearest-even C hexadecimal numbers; reject overflow/underflow, empty/whitespace-only/trailingjunk/JS alternate literals; native integral bounds abs<=1000000.
